title: PMF Experiment QA Manifest
description: Validates experiments/<slug>/qa/manifest.json — the one decision an experiment author makes about its QA gate, plus optional budgets. What to check is defined by the folder's auto-detected entrypoints (qa/main.py deterministic, qa/eval.md evaluator), not declared here, so there is no manifest-to-code drift. The two optional blocks are budget overrides: `deterministic` bounds the qa/main.py subprocess and `agent` carries the model and budgets for the qa/eval.md evaluator. Platform defaults are applied by the runner-image engine at runtime (JSON Schema `default` is documentation/editor hints only and is NOT injected by the validator, so a bare {"blocking": false} is valid).

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this meta-schema. Lets editors auto-complete fields. Not consumed by runtime.

blocking.description: The one decision: does a failing verdict block the artifact? false (observe) is the only posture v1 enforces — the artifact always publishes and the verdict rides along. true (blocking) is accepted but treated as false with a published warning until the deferred enforcement path ships.

deterministic.description: Optional overrides for the deterministic stage (qa/main.py subprocess). Omitted = platform defaults.

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock cap on the qa/main.py subprocess. Default 120.

agent.description: Optional overrides for the evaluator stage (qa/eval.md judge). Omitted = platform defaults. Used only when qa/eval.md is present; harmless on a deterministic-only folder. The runner-image engine applies the defaults at runtime and clamps max_turns to its own ceiling. Defaults are documentation/editor hints only and are NOT injected by the validator. The evaluator is meant to be lightweight and editorial — it scores quality against the artifact's own embedded content in a single read and does NOT web-search, re-fetch sources, or re-verify per-claim grounding (those are the deterministic qa/main.py stage's job), so a small budget is intentional. See experiments/CLAUDE.md, 'The QA folder'.

model.description: Model the evaluator agent runs under. Default sonnet.

max_turns.description: Turn budget for the evaluator agent, clamped to the engine ceiling. Default 20.

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock cap on the evaluator agent (enforced via asyncio.wait_for). Default 300.
